manual_review.visual: A broad domed mound is continuous with a flat tundra base, summit fissures are irregular rather than a circular crater, and one side sector exposes the pale-blue schematic core beneath a narrow soil edge. Reference and frozen brief explicitly avoid asserting this is an actual Ibyuk core or exact named-site reconstruction. Cutaway is prominent but limited to one bounded sector and does not imply broad natural ice exposure.
manual_review.view_review_note: Top/end/side and hero views preserve the dome while showing the cut section and fissures.
